verdict_reason: estimable holdout result does not clear support or refutation gates

estimate.method: OLS country/year FE with country-clustered standard errors

falsification_rule_text: Coverage must reach at least 700 country-years and 50 distinct countries; otherwise the run is INCONCLUSIVE. SUPPORT requires an interaction coefficient of at least +0.25 GDP-growth points per log-entry-by-one-unit rule-of-law change, a two-sided clustered p-value no greater than 0.10, and a model-implied entry-slope gap of at least +0.40 points between the sample rule-of-law 75th and 25th percentiles. REFUTATION requires an interaction no greater than -0.25 with p no greater than 0.10 and a model-implied gap no greater than -0.40. Every other estimable outcome is PARTIAL. Nonfinite uncertainty or failed estimation is INCONCLUSIVE.
limitations: Associational geographic holdout, not a causal estimate.
The old 60-country positive result was known when this follow-up was registered.
Registrations and WGI rule of law can reflect changing administrative measurement.
